pattern: SELECT COUNT(\*) FROM ([A-Za-z0-9]+) WHERE [A-Za-z0-9]+_id IN\(SELECT [A-Za-z0-9]+_id FROM ([A-Za-z0-9]+)\)
correction: Replace the COUNT(\*) with count(DISTINCT [table_name]_id) and remove the subquery

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that incorrectly uses a subquery in the WHERE clause, causing double counting of records.
